<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AskMenu" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuChoice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AskSide" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideChoice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenu" name="Ask menu or just burger"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu choice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuSplit" name="Prepare menu items in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSide" name="Ask fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" name="Receive side choice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the fries order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Menu items ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Event_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Status">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_StatusUpdateSent" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Event_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>customerChoosesMenu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>customerChoosesJustBurger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSide"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>customerChoosesFries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>customerChoosesWedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Event_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Event_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Event_StatusUpdateSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
